interpretation_rules: Adjustment equivalents are annual FY2036 arithmetic at implied CBO GDP, not 10-year scores.
Primary outlay changes exclude net interest; interest is paid, not relabeled as a program cut.
Revenue and outlay shares are illustrative mixes, not recommendations.
Debt stabilization depends on the effective interest rate, nominal GDP growth, starting debt, primary balance path, and other financing adjustments.
Distribution, timing, macroeconomic feedback, lawful commitments, and outcome floors require separate scoring.
next_gate: Build an annual 2026-2036 debt-dynamics model using CBO GDP, effective interest, primary balance, and other-means-of-financing series, then apply policy-specific phase-in and macroeconomic assumptions.
